name: Rosewood Home
description: Home furnishings retailer with 4 stores in the fictional city of Kelbridge.

items.title: Delivery charges
items.content: Delivery is free above $480; otherwise it costs $39 within Kelbridge and $64 beyond. Two-person delivery is available for sofas. Sheet RH-DEL-2.

items.title: Store opening hours
items.content: Kelbridge flagship on Weaver Street opens 09:50 to 18:10 daily, late night until 20:40 on Thursdays. Notice RH-HRS-1.

items.title: Display change schedule
items.content: Window displays change on the second Sunday of each month starting 07:05; visual merchandiser Clara Densmore signs off layouts. Schedule RH-VM-59.

items.title: Damaged stock procedure
items.content: Damaged items are photographed, logged in RH-DMG-7Q2 and sold in the clearance corner at 35% off after 9 days.

items.title: Staff kitchen supplies order
items.content: Tea, coffee and milk for staff come from Brewline Office Supplies every 2 weeks, about $112 per order, account RH-KIT-3307.

items.title: Planned franchise expansion
items.content: Rosewood will sign its first franchisee, Marla Venn, for a store in Ostley in 2027; the franchise fee is $120,000 plus 5.5% royalties. Plan RH-FR-6630-V.
